assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: square original card portrait for the Moss & Ember painted fantasy game
Primary request: An original portrait of the Gloamwing Cluster, exactly five small marsh creatures that rise together and follow emberseeds.
Scene/backdrop: A dusky marsh riverbank with softly blurred reeds, still water, and a few distant warm workshop lanterns.
Subject: Exactly five distinct, small violet marsh gliders in a close, readable group. Give each a rounded amphibian-like body, large clear golden eyes, delicate paired dragonfly wings with fine reed-vein patterns, and a tiny soft crest; make the wing shapes organic and delicate, with no resemblance to bats or owls. They wheel around three tiny emberseed lights as if following them. Show all five faces and enough of each creature's silhouette to count them at thumbnail size, without hiding anyone behind another.
Style/medium: Original hand-painted fantasy card illustration with softly sculpted forms, controlled brushwork, matte surfaces, clean silhouettes, and the warm atmospheric finish of the existing original card art.
Composition/framing: Tight square group portrait; exactly five creatures occupy the central area, fully inside a generous edge margin; faces and wings separated clearly for small card-thumbnail readability.
Lighting/mood: Violet twilight balanced by warm amber emberseed glow and faint copper reflections on the water; curious and alert.
Color palette: Muted violet and plum bodies, lilac wing highlights, dark marsh green, warm amber and restrained copper.
Materials/textures: Soft amphibian skin, translucent veined wings, reed silhouettes, painted mist, quiet river reflections.
Text (verbatim): None.
Constraints: Exactly five original creatures and three small emberseeds; original design, no copied commercial-game art or character; no symbols, captions, letters, UI, frame, border, watermark, or logo.
Avoid: Bats, owls, moths, armor, weapons, humanoid limbs, oversized teeth, extra animals, photorealism, glossy 3D plastic, flat vector art, text.
